description:
Season 1 takes viewers inside some of the toughest jails, revealing the daily challenges officers face and the harsh realities inmates endure. Deputy Deangelo Rolax leads a contraband and weapons shakedown at Washington Parish Jail, newly elected Sheriff Jason Smith struggles to bring a 40-year-old Leake County Jail up to his standards, officers carefully classify inmates to prevent conflicts at Bristol County Jail, and first-time inmate Giana Meyers calls her mom after being arrested for battery in Washoe County Jail.
#Discovery #120HoursBehindBars 

Stream Full Episodes of 120 Hours Behind Bars
https://go.discovery.com/show/120-hours-behind-bars-discovery-atve-us

About 120 Hours Behind Bars
Over five intense days, 120 Hours Behind Bars delivers an unfiltered look inside America's toughest jails -- where officers are outnumbered, cellblocks are overcrowded, and violence erupts without warning.
